scientific_scope_status: For fixed SPD storage and periodic reciprocal contacts, let Y be averaged terminal response and Y_* the static Kron reduction of the averaged graph. On terminal contrasts, Y_*-sym(Y)=<Z^T A Z>, a positive semidefinite matrix and Y^T Y_*^-1 Y<=sym(Y). Routing can be nonreciprocal but cannot improve total hot-subset cooling for two-level terminal temperatures in the admissible mean-conductance comparator class. With diagonal positive capacities, nonzero offdiagonal response occurs exactly along terminal-avoiding union-graph paths; forward and reverse zero patterns coincide.
